card.name: Units opening after a dosing quantity
card.fires_on: The small word or parenthesis right after a measured quantity such as weight, age, volume or clearance, where a unit like kg, mL or weeks comes next. Seen in dose formulas and table headers.

modes.label: Open parenthesis before unit
modes.description: A "(" after a quantity name in a formula or table header, just before a unit.
modes.example: Infusion rate (mL/hour) = target dose (mcg/kg/min) × body weight<< (>>kg) / 93

modes.label: "in" before unit
modes.description: The word "in" after a quantity, introducing its unit.
modes.example: *Calculate the injection volume for these patients by multiplying the patient weight<< in>> kilograms by 0.003

modes.label: Closing bracket after a formula term
modes.description: The end of a bracketed calculation just before the volume unit.
